edb42a8bcc.rewrite:
tzcnt eax,eax
sub rdi,rdx
lea rax,[rdi+rax*1+0x1]
shr rax,0x2
vzeroupper
edb42a8bcc.why: TZCNT produces a zero-extended value from 0 through 32, so the increment cannot wrap at 32 bits and can merge with the 64-bit addition in lea. The final shift receives the same value.
